body: Bhaiya namaste. Hum 6 bade hain aur 2 bacche (ek 8 saal aur ek 3 saal) plus ek 7 mahine ka infant. Hume December 22 se 28 tak Dubai ka family trip karna hai Indore se. Mummy ji (age 72) ko chalne me dikkat hai to airport aur sightseeing pe wheelchair assistance compulsory chahiye. Khana pure vegetarian/Jain chahiye hotel aur sightseeing me. Budget around 4.5 lakh total sab milakar. Aur humare textile firm ke naam par GST invoice banwana hai. Jaldi batao options.
